# @voidable/ui-hotwire

> Turbo morph protection for Voidable UI web components. Stimulus handles Voidable's custom events natively, so there is no controller to import.

## Install and use

```sh
npm install @voidable/ui @voidable/theme @voidable/ui-hotwire
```

```js
import '@voidable/theme';
import '@voidable/ui';              // or '@voidable/ui/autoloader'
import { VoidTurbo } from '@voidable/ui-hotwire';

VoidTurbo.start(); // idempotent; returns a function that detaches the listener
```

## API

- `VoidTurbo`: `start()` hooks Turbo morphs so reflected state (`open`, `checked`, `value`, ...) and the component's own `role` / `tabindex` / `aria-*` survive while the server renders the same value; the server wins when it renders a different one.
- Events: wire them with Stimulus `data-action`: `<void-button data-action="void-click->form#submit">`. The Rails gem's `void_attrs("void-click", "form#submit")` builds the attribute.

## Full reference

Every `<void-*>` element (parts, attributes with allowed values, events with `detail`, examples) is in the core package: `@voidable/ui/reference.md` (`node_modules/@voidable/ui/dist/reference.md`), summarised in `@voidable/ui/llms.txt`. Online: https://voidable.dev/llms.txt. Offline per element: `voidable ref <tag>`.
